functions.name: update_target_lock_aim_assist
functions.plate_comment: AIM ASSIST / TARGET LOCK MAGNETISM. Finds nearest lockable target in range, ramps in/out a rotation-speed pull toward it. Key struct offsets (param_1 = camera/aim state struct, r31): +0x108/+0x10c ramp factor X/Y (0..1, eases in/out of lock); +0x110/+0x114 FINAL assist speed X/Y (Maximum target speeds, added to camera rotation); +0x120/+0x121 has-target / is-locked flags; +0x138 locked target id; +0x144/+0x148 accumulator (m_targetLockSpeedX/Y) that builds up the pull. To disable the magnetism (Zadanie 6), patch the final fmuls before the two stfs at 0x3D9914/0x3D9918 (which produce +0x110/+0x114) into fsubs fD,fD,fD (self-zero): 0x003D9914 fmuls f0,f0,f12 -> fsubs f0,f0,f0 (0xEC000332 -> 0xEC000028); 0x003D9918 fmuls f13,f13,f11 -> fsubs f13,f13,f13 (0xEDAD02F2 -> 0xEDAD6828). This forces the assist contribution to 0.0 every frame while leaving lock-on bookkeeping/state/HUD untouched (low risk, no branch/cave needed).

comments.text: ZADANIE 6 candidate: fmuls f0,f0,f12 -> replace with fsubs f0,f0,f0 (0xEC000028) to zero the aim-assist X speed
ZADANIE 6 candidate: fmuls f13,f13,f11 -> replace with fsubs f13,f13,f13 (0xEDAD6828) to zero the aim-assist Y speed

functions.name: CameraShake_ApplyAllEffectors
functions.plate_comment:
Applies every active camera shake / noise effector to a camera transform (pos vec4 + quat vec4).
Args: f1 = time/strength, r3 = out transform, r6 = player index, stack+0x50 = input transform.
Three effector lists per player (TOC-0x7fec stride 0x20 / TOC-0x7ff0 stride 0x20 / TOC-0x7ff4 stride 0x4c), each entry's vfunc0 adds its offset; list C skips finished ones (vfunc +0x10).
g_CameraDebug_DisableShake (0x13257f3) != 0 -> output = input. Patch 'Disable Camera Shake' (0x8242cc lbz -> li r0,1) forces that path.
Called at the end of CameraControl*_CalculateTransform: Follow 0x1d5784, Zoom(ADS) 0x1ea54c, Balance 0x1bc2c4 and 7 other camera classes (virtual).
